title: A Corner of the Board
subtitle: After a life-long moment of waiting, two pieces are carefully placed here.

trails.title: IMPORTANT NOTICE
trails.description: Here are the rules about the Filibuster. It may come in handy one day.

content.text: Interpretation of the Supreme Court concerning Some Issues on the Use of Filibusters

Based on the current circumstances, this interpretation is hereby given in accordance with the relevant regulations and laws, in order to ensure the debates in the legislative process are carried out to serve its designated purpose, and the rights of the parties and interest groups involved are respected in the process.

Article 1 During the legislative debates, any member of the Joint Committee of the St. Pavlov Foundation who has doubt on the bill itself and requires explanation has the right to request an open debate from the chairperson. The chairperson in charge of the matter is obliged to accept this request.
...
...
Article 12 Within the 60 days of the legislative process and on the premise that all the parties are in compliance with the universally ratified Code of Conduct in the legislative period, both parties are entitled to an unlimited number of debates before the official voting on the bill and have the right to give up and withdraw from the debates.
Article 13 Termination of speech by either of the two parties will be considered as their withdrawal from the debate. The debate will hence end and the voting on the bill will be initiated. If the other party requests to continue with the speech, the Supreme Court will approve the proceeding of the debate. The debate will then last until that party requests voting or withdraw from the debate.
Article 14 Had no conclusion been drawn within 60 days, the Supreme Court shall determine the bill to be repealed. Any repealed bill will not be allowed to re-enter the legislative process within the next 5 years.
Article 15 In 10 days after the debate starts, both parties involved will be allowed to request voting to end the debate.
...
Article 20 The filibuster is a special legislative process established for controversial issues. Any bill being put through the filibuster process will require two thirds of the votes of the Committee members' to pass. The Supreme Court will determine the bills which has less than two thirds of the votes to be repealed.

items.text: A Corner of the Board

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: I was told you have something important to share?

items.speaker: Chairwoman
items.text: Yes, the filibuster is about to end.

items.speaker: Chairwoman
items.text: Z told me they are going to end the speech and apply for the official vote at noon.

items.speaker: Chairwoman
items.text: If you are going to continue with the debate, don't forget to send your men.
Constantine doesn't reply. She glances at the delegates on their seats.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Do you see Bernard over there?

items.speaker: Chairwoman
items.text: Yes.

items.speaker: Chairwoman
items.text: Quite a lot of his men attended today.

items.speaker: Chairwoman
items.text: They have remained uncommitted to Storm Reformation so far. I thought they wouldn't bother to attend ...

items.speaker: Chairwoman
items.text: The opposition side doesn't need a dozen more votes to win, after all.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: But the advocates of the draft do.
The chairwoman casts an eye on her, perplexed.
Yet Constantine doesn't intend to explain.
She looks weary.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: There will be a new draft given to you in two hours.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: I brought together a revision group last night with some hired experts. We have adjusted some of the articles in the previous draft.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: I will need you to present it to everyone when the time comes.

items.speaker: Chairwoman
items.text: What for?

items.speaker: Chairwoman
items.text: Is their draft going to be adopted?
The chairwoman looks ghastly. She can't help but ask again to confirm her suspicion.

items.speaker: Chairwoman
items.text: The draft is going to be adopted, isn't it?

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: ... There are things that even I cannot manoeuvre.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: All I can do is bring benefits to as many people as possible.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: I have specifically made some amendments to the clearance to educate and discipline unregistered arcanists in section 3 on page 21, as well as the duties and obligations of the Timekeeper's special team in section 1 on page 40.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Every arcanist assigned to the Timekeeper's department will be put through the Foundation's risk assessment and graded accordingly.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Ordinary arcanists only need to receive primary Artificial Somnambulism training. The more extraordinary ones will be sent to the School of Discipline for re-education.

items.speaker: Chairwoman
items.text: Delegate Mark also submitted another edition which was quite similar to this one.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Is that so?
She chuckles. It is a half-relaxed and half-bitter smile.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Heh heh, well ... very well.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: I'm pleased we have reached a consensus even before we meet.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Here are more things we have revised.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Given their resistance to the "Storm," the Timekeeper's special team will take up more work related to Manus Vindictae.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: The Foundation will utilize their abilities.
She sits down on her chair.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: We have also fine-tuned the details.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: They will be given more executive power, while the Foundation retains control over all things.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Remember, we have to make everyone aware of these changes before the voting starts.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: We have to make sure THIS version of the proposal is the one that gets the final approval in the end.

items.speaker: Chairwoman
items.text: Understood.
The chairwoman looks up. Lights shed on her reading glasses and give out a bluish white color.

items.speaker: Chairwoman
items.text: Can't believe this is happening ... Heh ...

items.speaker: Chairwoman
items.text: The first revolution targeting arcanists in the past decades ...

items.speaker: Chairwoman
items.text: Don't forget my stamps for this quarter, Constantine.
The right side of the hall is where the most eloquent people gather—the lecture area.
Madam Z stands on the podium. After the long speech lasting for days, she feels herself physically struggling to go on.
But her mind is getting clearer and clearer, more and more excited. Every cell in her body is ready to wake up at the very moment the voting starts.
She looks at the rostrum. Constantine is sitting next to the chairwoman calmly.
That is a strange calmness.
So strange that she is almost certain that she is watching Constantine place a piece on the bottom-right corner of the board.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: Am I so tired that my eyes are failing me?

items.speaker: Z
items.text: No. It's not the time to relax.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: Just two more hours. Hang in there. It will end soon …
TO BE CONTINUED…
